sloka: ततः प्रगृह्य दीप्ताग्रां कालदण्डोपमां गदाम् ।तां मूर्ध्नि पातयामास सावित्रो वै सुमालिनः ।। ७.२७.४७ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ pragṛhya dīptāgrāṁ kāladaṇḍopamāṁ gadām ।tāṁ mūrdhni pātayāmāsa sāvitro vai sumālinaḥ ।। 7.27.47 ॥

translations.english: Then, Savitri's son Vasu, having firmly grasped that mace with its blazing tip resembling the staff of Yama, struck it down upon Sumali's head.
